Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 77
Reason for Mistake: Upon reaching Fidelity’s mutual fund screener, WebSurfer failed to properly apply the critical filters (“International Equity” → “Emerging Markets” and “No Transaction Fee”) and got stuck repeatedly clicking without producing a filtered list. This prevented discovery of the full eligible set (including Fidelity Emerging Markets Index Fund, FPADX) and left the process fixated on FEMKX, ultimately causing the wrong final answer.
